segments._note: STRAIGHT LEAD-IN — must look essentially identical to today (heading is only the tiny folded serpentine sway). The cube enters straight before the bend.

BROAD BEND — the path HEADING ramps smoothly (smoothstep) from 0 through +120deg over 24u. The road GENUINELY TURNS in 3D (toward the +z camera side); physics is still the 1-D arc-length walk, so the cube follows the curving centre-line and YAWS to face along it. A `curve` is physically a flat run (use `height` to also slope it) whose only job is to carry the `turn` (degrees, +left = toward +z).
STRAIGHT OUT — the cube exits the bend onto a straight running at the new (+120deg) heading.
